Vibe is your AI agent for long-horizon tasks, fluent in your knowledge and tools. From a single conversation, it can think through complex work, draft solutions and deliver finished outcomes you can trust. All from your phone.

Core ways to use Vibe:
- Catch up across email, chat, calendar, and internal knowledge in one run
- Run deep research across the web, internal docs, and connected tools with sourced analysis
- Analyse spreadsheets and connected resources to surface patterns, anomalies, and key signals
- Draft reports, updates, and announcements from internal context
- And much more

Get started with Vibe today: Free for quick answers and simple everyday tasks and Pro for complex work and deeper reasoning. For custom deployments, model training, and dedicated support, contact us about Enterprise: https://mistral.ai/contact.
